caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass jar with a cylindrical body and a wide, slightly flared mouth. The glass is rendered in tones of pale blue and green, with highlights and shading that suggest reflections and refractions typical of clear glass. The jar is upright and centrally positioned on a plain, light background. Some embossed lettering is partially visible near the jar's shoulder, though the text is incomplete in this view. Subtle color gradients and shadowing provide the jar with a sense of dimensionality, and the artist's signature along with the date appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Fruit Jar
